verdicts.matching_evidence: Eq. (7) defines S=\frac{1}{N}\prod_{(i,j)\in S} V^{\rm cal}_{ij} e^{2\pi i\vec n\cdot(\vec r_j-\vec r_i)/\lambda}. This is dimensionally and statistically inconsistent with the surrounding text, which says the data from selected baselines are averaged. A product of N visibilities has units of visibility to the N-th power and will not estimate the mean beamformed solar response. The correct operation should be a sum or weighted sum over baselines.
